capabilities: Render quaestio code blocks as interactive multiple-choice questions in Reading view and Live Preview
Grade selections with Check and save answer state as flags in the note
Show or hide Correct Answer and Explanation panels
Reset questions to clear selections, highlights, and state flags
Score all questions in a note with a quaestio-dashboard block
extras: The README documents error cases shown when flags are missing, repeated, unknown, or inconsistent, but includes no screenshots or troubleshooting guidance beyond a 'Star history' heading.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed self-grading multiple-choice questions inside a note that persist selections and scores.
summary: Code-block plugin that renders quaestio blocks as interactive multiple-choice questions with saved answer state and per-note score dashboards.
